status: draft, hand-written by the engineering team; adds aliases and tags only, never slots, priorities or patient facts. The medical team's file rulebook/kb/routing_knowledge_base.json stays untouched; review and merge into it.
_notes: bundle_tags: extra task phrases per bundle (EN/DE), matched like the KB's own tags.
role_aliases: extra names for existing KB roles.
roles: roles the KB does not have yet; same fields as KB roles (default_bundles = what the role usually needs when the task wording is not recognised).
nephrologist (role): kidney_function at P1 via the role's modifiers; default task = medication review (renal dosing).

task_terms: synonym groups for the deterministic task-term promotion (engine/focus.py): a diagnosis whose label shares a significant clinical word with the situation text is shown in a 'Matches your task' group. Vocabulary only, no clinical reasoning.

task_relevance: clinical reasoning the KB does not have yet: when the situation names a task (when_any / when_all), facts whose label contains one of `terms` (or whose category is in `categories`) are shown in the same group with `why`. Every entry is source: TODO-cite until the medical team cites or rejects it.

intl (bundle_tags, role_aliases, roles[].aliases_intl): French, Spanish, Italian, Turkish and Arabic names, written accent-folded (engine/understand.norm_text folds é->e, ş->s, ğ->g, ı->i, Arabic alef variants). Vocabulary only; source TODO-cite, needs review by native-speaking clinicians.
role_stems: word stems that name a specialty in several languages (cardiolog- / kardiyolog-, onkolog- ...). Used only when no alias matched; the matching word counts as the role word.

role_fallback_bundles: what a recognised role sees when its task wording is not recognised (instead of the 4-card safety summary). Roles not listed use their first default bundle. Clinical judgement, source TODO-cite.

roles added 31 Oct (physician, sports_medicine, occupational_medicine, palliative_care, gastroenterologist, sleep_medicine, pulmonologist, toxicologist, infectious_disease, travel_medicine, haematologist, geriatrician, gynaecologist, obstetrician, paediatrician, neonatologist): engineering proposals, source TODO-cite; slots and priorities must be reviewed by the medical team.

topics: the named-topic lexicon (engine/focus.py). When the request names a topic, its facts (fact categories / ICD-10 / ATC / label pattern, plus optional KB slots) are shown open in the short view; if the record has none, a 'not documented' card names what was searched. Exclusions ('not interested in X', 'ohne X', 'sans X') suppress a topic. Every topic is source TODO-cite.

roles.name: Rheumatologist
roles.typical_situations: Lupus (SLE) review; bone health; medication review.
roles.mindset: Autoimmune disease, immunosuppression, bone health, drug interactions.
roles.often_missing: Lupus activity, serology and immunosuppressive treatment are not in the letters.

roles.name: Urologist
roles.mindset: Bleeding risk, kidney-relevant drugs, allergies.
roles.often_missing: No urological findings in the letters.

roles.name: Psychologist / psycho-oncology
roles.mindset: Diagnosis as told to the patient, social support, planned treatment.
roles.often_missing: Mental state and psychosocial history are not documented.

roles.name: Clinical social worker
roles.typical_situations: Discharge planning and support at home.
roles.mindset: What happens next, admission and discharge dates, support at home.
roles.often_missing: Social situation beyond family support is not documented.

roles.name: Nephrologist
roles.typical_situations: Kidney function review; renal dosing of medication.
roles.mindset: Kidney function and its trend, kidney-relevant drugs (metformin, ACE inhibitors/ARBs, diuretics, NSAIDs), contrast exposure.
roles.often_missing: Creatinine / eGFR are not documented in the letters.

roles.name: Physician
roles.typical_situations: Any doctor whose specialty is not stated.
roles.mindset: Core summary: diagnoses, medication, allergies, age.
roles.often_missing: Depends on the task.

roles.name: Sports medicine physician
roles.mindset: Cardiovascular risk, rhythm, heart function, medication affecting exercise.
roles.often_missing: Exercise test not documented.

roles.name: Occupational physician
roles.typical_situations: Fitness for work / return to work.
roles.mindset: Diagnoses and medication affecting work, mobility, vision.
roles.often_missing: Occupation and work demands are not documented.

roles.name: Palliative care physician
roles.typical_situations: Symptom control and goals of care.
roles.mindset: Diagnosis and stage, wishes / advance directive, support at home, analgesia.
roles.often_missing: Advance directive and symptom burden are not documented.

roles.name: Gastroenterologist
roles.mindset: GI diagnoses, blood thinners before endoscopy, allergies, medication.
roles.often_missing: Endoscopy findings are not documented.

roles.name: Sleep medicine physician
roles.mindset: Sleep apnoea, weight/BMI, blood pressure, sedating drugs.
roles.often_missing: Sleep study results and CPAP use are not documented.

roles.name: Pulmonologist
roles.mindset: Lung disease, smoking, oxygenation, weight.
roles.often_missing: Lung function tests are not documented.

roles.name: Clinical toxicologist
roles.mindset: Every drug she has access to, organ function, rhythm, weight.
roles.often_missing: Drug levels are not documented.

roles.name: Infectious disease physician
roles.mindset: Allergies, immunosuppression (e.g. SLE), kidney function for dosing, interactions.
roles.often_missing: Cultures and infection markers are not documented.

roles.name: Travel medicine physician
roles.mindset: Immunosuppression (SLE), interactions with malaria prophylaxis, allergies, chronic disease.
roles.often_missing: Vaccination history is not documented.

roles.name: Haematologist
roles.mindset: Blood thinners, blood count, coagulation.
roles.often_missing: Blood count and coagulation are not documented.

roles.name: Geriatrician
roles.mindset: Medication burden, mobility, cognition, support.
roles.often_missing: Falls history and cognition beyond MMSE are not documented.

roles.name: Gynaecologist
roles.mindset: Gynaecological history, breast cancer and its treatment plan.
roles.often_missing: Gynaecological history is not documented.

roles.name: Obstetrician / midwife
roles.mindset: Pregnancy, obstetric history.
roles.often_missing: Not applicable unless the patient can be pregnant.

roles.name: Paediatrician
roles.mindset: Child health.
roles.often_missing: Not applicable to an adult patient.

roles.name: Neonatologist
roles.mindset: Newborn health.
roles.often_missing: Not applicable to an adult patient.

task_relevance.why: Adjuvant endocrine therapy (aromatase inhibitors) accelerates bone loss: known osteoporosis changes monitoring and bone-protective treatment.
Connective-tissue disease (e.g. SLE) is a reported relative caution for radiotherapy (risk of severe acute and late toxicity).
Oncology discharge: the next planned procedure and its date are what the patient leaves with.

role_stems._note: Accent-folded word stems; a word starting with one names the role (first such word in the text). Only used when no alias matched. TODO-cite (vocabulary).

role_fallback_bundles._note: Recognised role, task wording not recognised -> these bundles (TODO-cite). Roles not listed: their first default bundle.

role_topics._note: Role-typical topics, taken from each role's own 'mindset' / 'often_missing' text (KB and overlay roles). engine/screen.py shows them as topic cards (found facts, or 'not documented' after searching every fact and passage) when the role's view comes from a bundle that is not its own: an overlay role (it borrows a KB bundle), or a KB role whose task wording was not recognised. Never on a question-only screen; within topics_settings.max_topic_cards. source: TODO-cite
